name: Orange Ultra Slim Notebook Style Water Bottle 380ml | Portable Memo Bottle for Travel, School & Office
description:
The Orange Ultra Slim Notebook Style Water Bottle 380ml is a stylish, portable memo-shaped bottle designed for everyday convenience. Made from BPA-free food-grade plastic, it slides easily into bags like a notebook. Its leak-proof lid and ergonomic carry-hole make it perfect for school, office, gym, travel, and outdoor activities. Lightweight, durable, and easy to carry, it keeps your drinks secure and accessible all day.Key Features:
 Ultra slim notebook-style portable bottle
 BPA-free food-grade plastic construction
 Leak-proof twist-lock lid
 Built-in carry-hole for easy handling
 Fits easily in backpacks, handbags, and laptop bags
 Suitable for cold beverages (380ml capacity)How to Use:
1⃣ Fill with water or cold beverage
2⃣ Secure the twist-lock lid tightly
3⃣ Carry using the side handle hole or place inside your bag
4⃣ Wash with mild soap and water after use
5⃣ Air-dry completely before next useIngredients / Materials:
Food-grade BPA-free plasticSafety Information:
